description: Call this FIRST before any other tool for this provider. Signs in with the corporate certificate and stores the session the efine query tools reuse. Call it first; call it again if a tool reports the session expired. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

business_registration_no.description: 사업자등록번호 - 숫자 열 자리(하이픈 없이). 예: 1234567890.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
